name: The Court of Mac and Cheese
source:
Tagliatella Rigatoni is alone in this world due to her parents' death and her unique purple eyes. When her eighteenth birthday arrives and she doesn't receive a Hsalhaerot and all the magic that comes with it, she's forced to leave her home and run from a horrible fate.

In her exile, she's personally picked by the fae prince, Aeddgeloard Darkn'brood, to compete in the Deathly Death Games of Death for the Death God. As an unspoken danger approaches, love blooms, things happen, and time to find the Maccanchees, the ultimate spellbreaker, runs out... will Rigatoni and Aeddgeloard save the world... or will they plunge it into the darkness?

[From [url=https://ednaarel.itch.io/the-court-of-mac-and-cheese]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于父母的去世和她独特的紫色眼睛，塔利亚泰拉·里加托尼在这个世界上是孤独的。当她十八岁生日到来时，她没有收到Hsalhaerot和随之而来的所有魔法，她被迫离开家，逃离可怕的命运。

在她的流放期间，她被精灵王子艾德杰洛德·达克恩布罗德亲自挑选，为死神参加死亡游戏。当一种无法言说的危险逼近时，爱情绽放，事情发生，寻找终极破法者马坎奇一家的时间已所剩无几……里加托尼和艾德杰洛德会拯救世界……还是将世界推入黑暗？

[来自[url=https://ednaarel.itch.io/the-court-of-mac-and-cheese]Itch.io[/url]]
